mechanics.claim: Knuckle Down resets Sett's basic attack timer, so the empowered attacks come out immediately without waiting for the normal attack interval.
mechanics.quote: Knuckle Down {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sett's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The two empowered attacks are guaranteed to land as a Left Punch followed by a Right Punch, and Knuckle Down resets Sett's current Pit Grit passive state, ignoring the usual time-out for a follow-up Right Punch.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attacks are guaranteed to be a {{as|Left Punch|Armor}} followed by a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}, resetting '''Sett's''' current {{ai|Pit Grit|Sett}} state (if applicable) and ignoring the usual time-out period for a follow-up {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage from Knuckle Down is capped at 400 total damage per attack against monsters (not relevant to a champion-dummy fight).
mechanics.quote: capped at 400 '''total''' damage of each attack against {{tip|monsters}}

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown does not begin until after its effect (both empowered attacks or the window expiring), not on cast.
